FULL TEXT:
Notification
National Health Mission Tamil Nadu
Health and Family Welfare Department
National Health Mission -Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN) invites
applications from eligible candidates for engagement of Staff Nurses
on contract basis, purely temporary in nature, as per NHM Norms,
through the District Health Society, Namakkal in the Comprehensive
Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) Including the
Special Newborn Care Units(SNCU) under the Directorate of Medical
and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education
and Research. Application should reach Office of the Executive
Secretary, District Health Society, Namakkal on or before
04.12.2026, 5.00 PM.

Note
1) Application form/ District-wise and institution-wise vacancy details can
be downloaded from NHM-TN website ( https://nhm.gov.in ).
2) Filled applications along with the relevant document photocopies should
reach to the abovementioned District Health Society address on or before
04.12.2026, 5.00 PM.
3) The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and
shall not confer any right to claim regularization. Selected candidates will
be placed, As per G.O.(Ms).No.427 Health and Family Welfare EAP-II/1
Department, Dated:18.11.2026
